> **Community Edition release**
>
> Verify the matching `.sha256` file before opening a download. Extract the archive completely, back up classroom worlds, and use classroom aliases rather than identifiable student records. OpenClassCraft remains an early preview unless this release explicitly states that the production gates have passed.

This public release contains Community game assets only. The School Console is a separately licensed, controlled pilot component and is not included.
